item.text:
The calendar tool confirms it created the event for Friday, October 16, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. on your calendar, and reports that invitations were sent. I included the Harbor Room at Pier 9 Events, the $1,400 cost, reference HR-2207, room/AV/lunch details, parking directions, and the team Tomas named: Priya, Lucia, Jonas, Amara, you, and Tomas.

Tomas said he would miss the offsite. His email said the venue was on hold and a 30% deposit was due October 9 to lock it in; I could not confirm whether the deposit was paid or the booking is now confirmed.
